[P1] Check the effective Athena result location

The query runner passes `athenaWorkgroup` to Athena, but this comparison uses only `athenaOutputLocation`. With `EnforceWorkGroupConfiguration`, the workgroup can override an apparently safe output location with one inside a scanned data partition. This check then returns `read-only`, and the gate allows queries without consent for the process lifetime. Resolve the effective workgroup output location before classifying it, or return `unknown` when that location cannot be established.
